newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle off $1 at $114/dressed - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle off $1 at $114/dressed - USDA.

text.p: Trade fairly active on Thursday morning, USDA said. Steers and heifers steady to $1.00 per cwt lower on a dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights). Dressed Basis Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1350 lbs 113.50- 114.00. Dressed Basis Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 113.50- 114.00.
Prices on slaughter steers and heifers on a live basis mostly steady. Buyer inquiry and demand fairly good with seller interest mixed.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1250-1350 lbs 70.50-72.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1125-1200 lbs 71.00-72.00. Confirmed - 6,000 For the week - 29,100
